english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for deliberately watching or examining something carefully.
Use this for deliberately observing something, especially over a period of time.

examples.english: I carefully observe the little bird.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 sam1 gun1 caat3 zek3 zoek3 zai2

examples.english: After observing the bird all morning, I notice that it is unusually noisy.
examples.traditional: 我觀察隻雀仔成個朝早，發現佢特別嘈。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gun1 caat3 zek3 zoek3 zai2 seng4 go3 ziu1 zou2 faat3 jin6 keoi5 dak6 bit6 cou4
